m.description:
The number of bits. The more bits per expected entry, the lower the false positive probability.

@see #requiredM

k.description:
The number of hash functions to use. The more hash functions, the lower the false positive probability.

@see #requiredK

_hasher.description: Lambda that produces an integer hash of the value using a specified seed.

title:
A complete implementation of a Bloom filter using Murmur3 32-bit hash function, with a different seed chosen for
each of the hash functions (_k_).

It also supports serializing and deserializing as a string. The string contains the value tyoe, _m_, _k_, and the
bits encoded in Base64.
name: BloomFilter.Murmur
